notes: Account summary: Global payments platform, heavy real-time chat for merchant support + reranking for fraud signals. Primary ask: reserved GPU pools with multi-region failover headroom and hard latency SLOs. Wants to avoid episodic throttles; cost-sensitivity but prioritizes reliability for payments flow. Specific asks: (1) guaranteed sustained throughput during 99th pct traffic bursts, (2) cross-region failover within 30s, (3) 20-30% warm headroom reserved per region for failover, (4) audit logs + HSM/KMS integration, (5) legal requests explicit SLA downtime credit schedule. SE notes: likely need mix of H100-80GB equiv for large LLM reranking and 8-bit quantized M60/H100 for conversational tiers. POC scope: 6-week POC, 2 regions (us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 DR), scheduled performance gates at weeks 2,4,6.
workload_profile: Chat primary: conversational context windows up to 4k tokens, p95 latency goal 150ms for short-turn responses; Reranking: batch jobs for fraud scoring with tight tail latency p95 < 300ms for 512-token inputs; Embeddings: offline bulk jobs + online 100qps spike handling.
latency_targets: Chat p95 <= 150ms (95% of requests), Chat p99 <= 400ms; Reranking p95 <= 300ms; Embeddings per-item latency < 50ms for online queries.
throughput_targets: Steady-state peak: 12k tokens/sec across cluster; Burst target: 25k tokens/sec for up to 5 minutes (holiday/tax-season spikes). Embeddings: sustained 200 qps online with 2k qps batch ingestion window.
reserved_gpu_requirements: Prelim ask: Regional reserved pools: us-east-1: 24 x H100-equivalent GPUs (primary for chat + rerank), us-west-2: 12 x H100-equivalent GPUs (failover/capacity headroom). Plan uses 20-30% warm headroom per region. Preference for multi-AZ spread (min 3 AZs) to avoid single-AZ blips. Consider hybrid: Dedicated + Private (on-prem DR) for regulatory workloads.
batching_and_kernel_strategy: SE recommendation: mixed batching windows with latency-aware continuous batching for chat; large rerank workloads to use synchronous micro-batching; use quantized kernels for 70% of chat load to reduce GPU footprint; reserve unquantized GPUs for high-fidelity rerank runs.
failure_domains_and_failover: Failover RTO target: < 30s for routing to secondary region; planned headroom to absorb 1.5x peak for 5 minutes. Use health-based routing + KV-cache priming on warm replicas. Need cross-region KV warm-up strategy and prefix cache replication plan.
sla_negotiation_points: Customer wants: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated pool, 99th/95th tail latency SLOs with credits, maintenance windows restricted to off-peak PST, right to audit, 72-hour response for Sev1 incidents. Legal pushing back on credit caps; Redwood to propose multi-tier credits tied to p95/p99 misses.
poC_plan: 6-week POC. Week 1: environment setup + security validation. Week 2: baseline perf tests (latency/throughput). Week 3-4: load ramp + failover drills between AZs/regions. Week 5: tuning (batching, quantization, kernel selection). Week 6: final sign-off + pricing/contract draft.
decision_criteria: (1) Clear throughput guarantees and measurable SLO definitions, (2) Multi-region reserved capacity with documented failover headroom, (3) Security posture (SSO, KMS, audit logs, SOC2/ISO), (4) Price per token and headroom economics, (5) SLAs and legal acceptable terms.
financials_and_pricing_notes: Expecting committed ARR ~ $500k-$1M with 12-24 month reserved contract. Interested in blended pricing: reserved capacity + overage per-token. Wants a simple headroom charge model (flat % over reserved baseline) rather than dynamic spot pricing.
